text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to the cafeteria for lunch, when…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah! You gotta try this too, Trainer! Chubby-wubby!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: My belly is soft like a marshmallow! Chubby-wubby! It feels so good!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Come on, it may be fun, but you'll never become an adult acting like this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: If your belly gets any bigger… you might not be able to fit into your signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! I wanna keep fitting into my racewear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After many extra training sessions, Haru Urara's "chubby-wubby belly" days are over.
